#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

const int maxN = 1000005;
const int mod = 1000000007;

int dp[17];

int solve(int n, int t)
{
    if (t == 0) {
        if (n == 0) return 0;
        return mod;
    }

    int cnt = n / dp[t];
    if (n % dp[t] == 0) return t * cnt;
    return cnt * t + min(solve(abs(n - dp[t] * (cnt + 1)), t - 1) + t, solve(n - dp[t] * cnt, t - 1));
}

int main()
{
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    dp[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < 17; i++)
        dp[i] = dp[i - 1] * 10 + 1;

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    cout << solve(n, 16) << endl;

    return 0;
}
